title: Caleb Williams moves closer to a return — and the Bears need him

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Caleb Williams moves closer to a return — and the Bears need him
sources.description: The Bears had won two games in a row without quarterback Caleb Williams, who suffered a hamstring injury in a Week 2 loss to the Vikings.
